parts.html: The K-21 kitchen is a white neoclassical L-shaped kitchen. Light solid-color fronts create a sense of order and lightness, while work surfaces, appliances, and cabinets run along two adjacent walls.

White makes this model a versatile foundation for any interior. The kitchen pairs harmoniously with wood textures, stone surfaces, light ceramic tile, and decorative accents in warm tones. The neoclassical style suits those who prefer a calm interior with references to traditional aesthetics but without excessive ornamentation.
At 4.7 linear meters, it leaves free space for a dining area or a walkway. The standard model has no island.

The upper and lower fronts have a foil-wrapped finish. A single white color unites the furniture into a cohesive composition. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based. The design accommodates built-in appliances.

The standard configuration includes Muller soft-close hinges that ensure the doors close smoothly. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included; a cargo pull-out and lift-up mechanisms are not.
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close
We make the K-21 to fit your kitchen — with more functional hardware, additional storage systems, and materials that cost less or more than the standard ones.
